LESSON: METALLIC MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Materials for Production
Topic 3.2: Metallic Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Metallic Materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Explain the main ideas in Metallic Materials
2. Practise Metallic Materials at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Metallic Materials

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Explain the main ideas in Metallic Materials
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the main ideas in Metallic Materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. Practise Metallic Materials at school and at home
   In simple words: practise until you can practise Metallic Materials at school and at home. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Metallic Materials
   In simple words: practise until you can give Kenyan examples connected to Metallic Materials. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Metallic Materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Metallic Materials in the examples.
2. Explain Metallic Materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Metallic Materials.
4. Practise one skill from this lesson with a friend.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Metallic Materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Metallic Materials important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Explain the main ideas in Metallic Materials
2. Practise Metallic Materials at school and at home
3. Give Kenyan examples connected to Metallic Materials

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
